articles.summary: American Airlines celebrated the launch of daily nonstop service between Miami (MIA) and Cap-Haitien, Haiti (CAP), restoring the airline’s presence in Haiti and marking a historic milestone in the airline’s centennial year as the 100th destination served in its Latin America and Caribbean network.
articles.title: American Airlines returns to Haiti with all-Haitian crew, marking 100th destination served in the region

articles.summary: The new agreement is a great deal for taxpayers, unlocking significant airline-funded infrastructure investments to support continued growth and enhance the experience for customers traveling to, through and from Charlotte.
articles.title: American Airlines strengthens 40-year Charlotte commitment with new 10.5-year agreement
